correctness.rationale: A self-contained flag-complex lower-bound/equality proof reduces the minimal supports to six path-block partitions. Exhaustive exact-cover enumeration constructs 297 unique supports, complete 216-automorphism enumeration gives the five orbit sizes. A complete acyclic augmented Morse matching on 35,368 faces yields a 43-by-3 integer boundary with a unit minor; every original degree-six boundary reduces to that lattice. All 297 fundamental cycles are checked integral cycles with gcd-one quotient coordinates; orbit Smith forms are primitive of ranks 40/25/35/31/5; a 40-by-40 determinant equals -1. A separate mod-two boundary calculation independently verifies degree-five rank 40. The programs and inputs are embedded as standalone files.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Complete-graph and chessboard matching connectivity theorems do not specialize to an arbitrary 27-edge Pappus graph carrier basis. The forest theory excludes the cyclic Pappus graph; the manifold matching-complex characterization does not give homology supports in this nonpure complex. The known flag-support lower bound establishes a general 12-vertex threshold but does not count the 297 actual Pappus carriers, prove each primitive, determine automorphism orbit ranks, or give a same-orbit integral basis.

value.rationale: The minimum induced support and integer homology subgroup generated by each orbit are natural structural invariants of a canonical 18-vertex symmetric incidence graph. They are not consequences of a wedge-of-40-spheres theorem. The five inequivalent supports, 297 exact carriers and basis confined to a single transitive orbit explain how local minimal spheres generate all global integral fifth homology. The exact, nontrivial finite enumeration resolves a well-motivated local-to-global classification without claiming general graph-family coverage.
